description: Dependency updates for facet. AGENTS.md, section Dependency updates, explains the rules.

customManagers.description: A version pin with a `# renovate:` comment on the line above it: the Go tool pins in the Makefile and the security tools in security.yml.

packageRules.description: The go directive is the oldest Go the module accepts. Raise it by hand.
setup-go installs the newest patch of the go.mod series ('1.25' with check-latest). Move it with the go directive, by hand.
Patch and digest updates merge by themselves when every check is green.
The checksum next to each version must change with it, and Renovate cannot fetch it. The PR goes red at the checksum step until a person or a session updates it.
prBodyNotes: Update the matching `*_SHA256` in `security.yml` in this PR. The checksums are on the release page (gitleaks: `gitleaks_<v>_checksums.txt`, Linux x64; zizmor: the `zizmor-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` asset digest).

packageRules.description: A major update never merges by itself.
